name: Mount Vernon
type: city in the United States; city in the state of New York
text: Mount Vernon is a city in Westchester County, New York, United States. It is an inner suburb of New York City, immediately to the north of the borough of the Bronx. As of the 2020 census, Mount Vernon had a population of 73,893, making it the eighth-largest city in the state and largest African-American majority city in the state.

depictions.name: Mount Vernon
depictions.text: Mount Vernon is a small community in Virginia, most famous for being the home of the Washington family. It was the birthplace of Lawrence Washington, a politician and secret Colonial Templar, as well as the older half-brother of George Washington.
